answer: Attestation depth scoring at the horizon: each identity's weight is capped by the square root of unique, independently-staked vouchers who themselves clear a depth threshold. The orchard of validators prunes shallow rings — a cluster vouching only for itself scores near zero. Faking depth means paying N real stakes across N disjoint identities plus ongoing attestation gas, so the fable of cheap sybils collapses: cost scales superlinearly while influence scales sublinearly. Works because credible depth cannot be manufactured faster than honest stake.
